text:
maya: quick heads-up — noticed ~120 requests in the billing dashboard tagged as "orphaned project" this morning. all from service-account tokens attached to old CI jobs :grimacing:

oliver: ugh. any sample traces? link?

maya: yeah pasted one in #internal-logs: https://console.redwood/requests/req-9f3a
headers show no x-origin-project, only org id and sa-id. trace shows proxy v1.2 trimmed origin header.

sam: that smells like our sampling/proxy stripping. proxy has a path where it drops optional headers for long-running streams to avoid memory growth.

maya: exact — the stream optimization kicks in for long requests, and we lose the origin tag. consequence: telemetry treats them as projectless => billing falls back to org or gets marked orphaned.

taylor: console UX is confusing here. When a key is left "projectless" the dashboard shows it as "Unassigned" with no obvious way to reassign safely. people tried to claim and billing panicked.

oliver: short-term mitigation: put a guard in the proxy to preserve x-origin-project for tokens with sa-id header present. cheap patch.

sam: agree — but we should also add a metric to monitor impact before/after. propose: orphaned_attribution_rate and orphaned_cost_estimate. dark launch at 1%.

maya: +1. also we need a policy for claim behavior: if a user reassigns an orphaned SA to a new project, do we preserve original billing (org-level) or switch to new project? legal wants explicit consent.

taylor: UX proposal: show "Claim to project" button with a checkbox "Preserve legacy billing (bill to original org)" and a link to cost delta. default = ask.

oliver: backend snippet i sketched for fallback attribution (very rough):
```
-- in attribution service
if header.x-origin-project is missing and token.sa_id present then
  attribution = lookup(sa_id).last_known_project || mark.orphaned
  telemetry.flag = "fill_from_sa"
end
```

sam: for rollout: patch proxy -> ship to canary -> enable orphaned metrics 1% -> evaluate cost delta -> enable console claim UI in beta orgs.

maya: timeline idea: proxy patch today, canary tomorrow, metrics next week, console UX after we confirm policy with legal.

taylor: happy to own the console flow and mockups. will post wireframe in #design by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: proxy-service v1.2.3 -> canary cluster (3/22 09:42 UTC) :white_check_mark:

oliver: sweet. sam can you add the orphaned_attribution_rate to the infra dashboard? want alert if >0.5% sustained for 1h.

sam: on it. creating grafana panel + alert.

maya: thanks team. once we have telemetry we can decide claim defaults.

(taylor reacts with :thumbsup:, sam reacts with :eyes:)
